data.desc: Metropolitan Commercial Bank ('MCB') is a New York City-based, full-service commercial bank serving businesses, institutions and individuals who value expertise, responsiveness and long-term relationships. Since 1999, MCB has built enduring client relationships, many spanning generations, through personalized, relationship-driven banking. The Bank provides commercial, business and personal banking solutions, with specialized expertise in real estate, property management, legal services, healthcare, government banking and EB-5 financial solutions. Its capabilities also include title and escrow services, 1031 exchanges and merchant acquiring. MCB has earned national recognition for its performance and growth, including Newsweek's Best Regional Banks in 2024 and 2025 and Business Insider's America's High-Growth Companies in 2026.
